photos.observed: Cream station hall, red pilasters and large broad rectangular red elevated crown. Wide low gabled entrance roof with red edge fascia; central small terracotta pyramidal roof and finial. White trilingual fascia black letters on gablefront. Three pale entrance columns, open corridor, metal handrails.
Wide island platform with red edge paving strip/yellow safety line. White butterfly canopy trusses. Some blue canopy edges. Continuous electric catenary.

uncertainty: Room arrangements, heights, footprint and current facade condition not surveyed. Architecture reflects dated photographed phase.
